Next month SCOTUS will consider a lawsuit to gut the #CleanAirAct, which has helped protect the health of Americans for 50+ years. 

Proud to join 190+ colleagues today in an amicus brief to defend American families from those who would put polluters’ profits before public health

This #BlackMaternalHealthWeek, I am proud to join the @BMHCaucus to recognize the importance of improving health equity for Black mothers and raise national awareness about ways we can strengthen reproductive justice for all.
 
Learn more at https://t.co/xd2YP4aBpE. https://t.co/7rOGCGLFqr

Should this ruling be finalized, I am disheartened that our grandchildren must face the same battles of two generations past. Now, we must do everything in our power to stand up for women’s healthcare and fight for their equal treatment under the law.

Today, I spoke on the House Floor in support of the #InflationReduction Act.

This bill will help all Americans by lowering health care & energy costs, reducing inflation & the national deficit, and by making the largest investment in the environment in our nation's history. https://t.co/2efKyAJGRM

Through the Inflation Reduction Act, we in Congress are paving the way for increased access to affordable healthcare, sustainable energy resources, and a cleaner environment—critical issues our country cannot delay action on any further.

https://t.co/LQjHV8hN2U https://t.co/4nEQ9hVNFY

Today, I am pleased to be hosting my friends from @RodaleInstitute, @SerenbeFarms, and @GilliardFarms in Washington D.C. for a full @HouseAgDems committee hearing to discuss supporting regenerative agriculture and soil health for farms in Georgia and across the country. https://t.co/qKCz1UGNbu

As chairman of @HouseAgDems, I was pleased to host a hearing this month with regenerative agriculture experts to discuss ways that we can improve soil health in Georgia and across the nation. After the hearing, I caught up with my friends at @WSBTV. Check out my interview here: https://t.co/wdMSLv3U1z

Uninsured? Here’s your chance to #GetCovered!
 
Between November 1 and December 15, families and individuals can enroll in affordable #ACA coverage for 2023 on https://t.co/LW23vifKcC.

Online support is available at the https://t.co/LW23vifKcC Call Center: 1-800-318-2596. https://t.co/ev7rvu49dE

Today, I am proud to introduce the Consumer Financial Education and Empowerment Act.

This bill will play a vital role in strengthening financial education resources and will help improve the overall financial health and well-being of families in #GA13 and across the country. https://t.co/EDyTB2aP76
Wishing everyone in Georgia's Thirteenth District a #HappyNewYear and a blessed 2023! May the year ahead bring you good health, peace, and prosperity! https://t.co/hqzM6Kx74w

Yesterday, I was proud to join @USDANutrition at the first regional nutrition summit to discuss nutrition security and ways Congress support can promote food access and healthy eating for all in the upcoming farm bill. https://t.co/Qcjd1dIJpN

Approximately 42 million Americans rely on SNAP to maintain nutritionally adequate diets each year.

Now is not the time to make cuts to one of the most important tools we have to increase food and nutrition security in this country. #DefendSNAP

Today, I published an op-ed in @TheHill, where I discussed why defending and protecting the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) in this year’s farm bill is critical for the well-being of America’s families.

Read More: https://t.co/5QRw4DELPQ https://t.co/yjF5fyZYLK

June is #MensHealthMonth, a time to raise awareness about the health issues affecting men and boys. Let's continue working to foster open conversations about mental health and emphasize the importance of preventive care. https://t.co/gbnAQMT0fV

Proud to stand with the 340,000 UPS @Teamsters who are taking a stand for fair wages, safe working conditions, affordable healthcare, and dignified retirement. UPS workers are essential and deserve their fair share.

Standing in solidarity with UAW Local 868 and nationwide UAW strikers for fair wages, safer workplaces, and an end to pay disparities and forced overtime. SAG proved strikes work. Together, let's demand better working conditions and fair treatment. #UAWStrike #UAWSolidarity

Health care is key to disease prevention and vital for your physical, mental, and emotional well-being. Assist loved ones with health coverage through #ACA Open Enrollment today!

Sign up by December 15 for coverage beginning in 2024: https://t.co/6uomjsBM5U. https://t.co/92pFculexs

Today I sent a letter to the Commissioner of the Georgia Dept. of Corrections seeking answers regarding the state of healthcare in Georgia Correctional Facilities. Read the full Press Release here: https://t.co/YVp1mKxTOU https://t.co/GQ8eEFQFXX

14 years ago, I voted for the transformational Affordable Care Act. Known as Obamacare, this bill provided healthcare for millions of Americans, protected people with preexisting conditions, and expanded Medicaid. I will continue the fight for affordable healthcare.

Two years ago the Inflation Reduction Act was signed into law. I was proud to support this bill as it increases access to affordable healthcare, sustainable energy and funds programs to fight climate change. https://t.co/NhvWgryAAL
Today in GA-13, we’re seeing real benefits: residents with ACA insurance are saving an average of $480 a year on health premiums and $228 on prescriptions because of the IRA.
It is of the utmost importance to uphold our obligation to our veterans by continuing to fight for expanded VA education, healthcare, and support for military families.

Today, I brought together reps from the VA, IRS, Senior Medicare Patrol, and ARC’s Aging Services to share resources with constituents in Gwinnett. Thanks to Gwinnett County for hosting us. I will always work to make government work for you. If I can help, call my office! https://t.co/0WLrjERu8N

House Republicans' budget bill is a huge rip off for hard-working Georgia families. Cutting TRILLIONS from SNAP, Medicaid, education & children’s healthcare to pay for corporate tax breaks is reckless & unconscionable. I will oppose any effort to slash these services. Read my statement here:

This blatant attack on #CDC workers in Atlanta is shameful & unjust. Dedicated public health professionals are being forced out w/ zero recourse. The consequences of this reckless action will be felt by thousands of families & cost the government millions. https://t.co/4P8r4vlel0
